title: InferenceConfig
description: Inference parameter snapshot captured alongside evaluations and benchmark runtime profiles for reproducibility.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0–2). Null means the server default was used.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability (0–1). Null means the server default was used.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens. Null means no override.

stream.description: Whether the request should ask the server for a streamed response. Null means no override.

seed.description: Deterministic sampling seed when the target server supports it. Null means no override.

stop.description: Stop sequence or sequences. Null means no override.

presence_penalty.description: Presence penalty applied by compatible servers. Null means no override.

frequency_penalty.description: Frequency penalty applied by compatible servers. Null means no override.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Null means the caller or server default was used.

unsupported_parameter_policy.description: How benchmark/evaluation execution should handle parameters unsupported by the selected server.

quantization_level.description: Legacy evaluation-only quantization hint. New benchmark contracts keep quantization under model.architecture.quantisation and precision under model.architecture.precision.
